correctness.rationale: PASS: First-party source [1, Lemma 4.1] identifies commutation-completion cost with half the fixed binary symmetrized rank. A cyclic-unit factorization reduces Γ to (1+x^{b-a})(1+x^{a+b}) mod (x^n-1). The kernel dimension equals gcd degree; separability of x^m+1 gives the exact root-multiplicity formula. Coprime odd divisors and complete 2-adic parity cases show κ≤n/2+1 if n≡2 mod4 and κ≤n/2+2 if 4|n. The admissible connected family (1,n/2−1) attains equality for every n. The standalone verifier independently recomputed 21,152 exact binary ranks for even n=6..72; this supports, but cannot replace, the all-order proof.

originality.rationale: PASS: The underlying general mixed-rank identity is already Riera--Parker--Stănică Lemma 4.1 and is not asserted novel. Damnjanović Theorem 14 gives the closest published all-connected-quartic extremum, but for ordinary complex/real nullity; at Circ(12,{1,5}) that nullity is 6 whereas binary nullity is 8, defeating implication. Williams handles specific integer Smith forms and Deaett--Meyer handles variable Hermitian circulant minimum rank. Actual targeted research-record and source searches found no binary all-even-order ancillary optimum. Remaining risk: other indexing or unnamed characteristic-two specialization may exist.
residual_risks: The literature may contain a weakly indexed direct binary-rank optimum under polynomial-circulant or finite-field adjacency terminology.

value.rationale: PASS: The optimization criterion is canonically dictated by the mixed-graph-state commutation-completion construction. The theorem supplies a sharp exact resource minimum for every even ring size with a fixed connected two-shift hardware-style architecture, not an arbitrary finite slice. Binary/ordinary nullity discrepancies at n=10 and 12 expose a nontrivial characteristic-two effect, and the construction realizes the optimum at every size. It does not claim a universal quantum-gate lower bound or uniqueness.
